source_refs.title: Lore
source_refs.relevance: Grounds the setting as a living magical ecology under industrial pressure and distinguishes competing cultural interpretations from settled world knowledge.

source_refs.title: Mastership and citizenship
source_refs.relevance: Primary institutional source: open but workshop-bound civic franchise, local-first jurisdiction, public complaint and audit, plus the fixture-authored burden-claim and answering-table procedure.

source_refs.title: Halflings
source_refs.relevance: Grounds agricultural dependence on dwarven pumps, careful long-term field observation, glassy crop mutation, and demands for alternate crystal supply and restitution.

source_refs.title: Dwarves
source_refs.relevance: Grounds durable craft, seal-bearing Mastership across ancestry, infrastructure dependence, and the political weight of keeping water and other public systems running.

source_refs.title: The Greathold
source_refs.relevance: Grounds connected Holds, gate markets, guild law, contract expertise, and jurisdiction widening outward with material consequence rather than descending from a permanent capital.

source_refs.title: Dwarven industry
source_refs.relevance: Grounds forge consortiums, deep companies, insurers and public institutions as distinct interests, and makes reserve power and pump continuity material constraints on relief.

source_refs.title: Runic engineering
source_refs.relevance: Grounds crystal-fed pump engines, visible runic interfaces, municipal dependence, and the displacement created by standardized power machinery.

source_refs.title: Surface symptoms
source_refs.relevance: Grounds crop mutation, uncertain attribution, overlapping records, and downstream councils sending evidence against machinery they cannot vote on.

source_refs.title: International crisis
source_refs.relevance: Grounds foreign dependence on dwarven pumps and the diplomatic difficulty of removing power systems before a viable substitute exists.

historical_context.time_period: Early public attribution disputes, after foreign pump dependence and surface crop mutations have both become politically visible
historical_context.location: Rillgate Contract Hall at a surface-facing Greathold freight gate; Brackenwash is a fixture-local halfling farming town connected by an export pump contract.
historical_context.tonal_mode: Warm procedural wit with agrarian stakes: bureaucracy is funny because people have made it usable, and frightening because crops continue changing while it works.
historical_context.summary: Brackenwash speaker Pella Reedbank lodges a burden claim against a crystal-fed pump contract. Rillgate's answering table must distinguish evidence custody, contract provenance, conflicts of interest, interim power, and material redress without claiming certainty about the injured ecology.

public_facts.text: Halfling agricultural communities use dwarven enchanted pumps and preserve long field records that can reveal slow magical ecological change.
Greathold jurisdiction begins near the affected matter and widens when consequences or required remedies cross Hold and route boundaries.
A foreign claimant needs no civic seal to lodge a burden claim, but the deciding authority remains with unconflicted workshop seals assembled through the affected moot.
A marked drawdown can isolate a named disputed crystal lot and use a named reserve or substitute supply, but the procedure cannot invent power or erase the resulting service cost.

ambient_pressures.text: Brackenwash needs its pump to keep working even while its inhabitants suspect the power supply is contributing to crop mutation.
Rillgate can bind local contract custody, reserves, surety and workshops; it cannot settle the nature of the world-spirit or command a foreign town.
Commercial interdependence can make every technically qualified seal financially interested, turning conflict disclosure into a condition of legitimate judgment.

groups.label: Brackenwash town claimants
institutional_logic: Keep irrigation running while forcing the export contract to answer for possible harm.
Preserve field observation and sample custody outside the supplier's files.
material_incentives: Secure alternate crystal or a safe repair before the next irrigation turns.
Recover seed, livestock-care and inspection costs without surrendering evidence.
internal_shames: Letting a claim become somebody else's speech
Winning compensation while the field keeps changing
prestige_markers: A field book kept across seasons
A sample whose custody survives travel
A pump kept useful on safer terms
taboo_triggers: Calling crop injury a warranty inconvenience
Demanding that the town choose between proof and water before alternatives are counted
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as dates, duplicate jars, livestock names, pump schedules, and jokes too exact to be soothing.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated field observation and independent custody; treats supplier speed as useful but interested.

groups.label: Rillgate answering table
institutional_logic: Assemble unconflicted civic seals in the smallest jurisdiction able to reach both cause and remedy.
Keep clerical routing, technical testimony and judgment as separate authorities.
material_incentives: Protect the legitimacy of Greathold contracts without privatizing cross-border harms.
Spend reserve crystal only against a bounded and inspectable order.
internal_shames: A paid supplier judging its own cord
A seal pretending to create resources
prestige_markers: An order that names its cost
A claim widened before local authority becomes fiction
taboo_triggers: Private settlement presented as public redress
Foreign harm dismissed because the claimant lacks a Greathold vote
emotional_display_norms: Alarm is compressed into docket marks, recusal, reserve counts and increasingly specific questions.
trust_defaults: Trusts witnessed custody and disclosed interests more than rank, wealth or expert certainty.

groups.label: Rillgate power exporter
institutional_logic: Keep installed pumps operating and disputed harms inside warranty terms.
Prevent one local claim from freezing a crystal lot shared by many buyers.
material_incentives: Avoid reserve draw, surety payment, lot disclosure and widened claims.
Preserve the exporter's reputation for continuous operation.
internal_shames: A provenance chain that becomes an accusation
prestige_markers: A dispute closed as ordinary service
taboo_triggers: Treating uncertain ecological attribution as settled liability
Letting a small foreign buyer bind an entire shared lot
emotional_display_norms: Fear becomes helpful speed, narrowed definitions, clean gloves and concern for other customers.
trust_defaults: Trusts controlled inspection and warranty custody; distrusts public records that combine technical uncertainty with political pressure.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The town cannot treat stopping its pump as costless, so useful resistance must preserve service, evidence, or a named substitute rather than perform purity.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give Pella choices among custody, provenance, public testimony, interim supply and restitution; each route spends time or leverage.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The seals can bind only named Greathold owners and resources; an honest order identifies its jurisdiction, its evidence and who pays its service cost.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep the bench from declaring ecological truth or solving scarcity by fiat.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A rapid private repair protects service and supplier reputation while pulling evidence out of public custody.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Orik's offer materially useful, institutionally narrowing, and therefore difficult to refuse cleanly.

observer_read: Political attempt to settle uncertain causation
target_self_read: A town preserving evidence because the supplier has stronger custody
misread_patterns: Supplier speed can mistake the desire for continued water as consent to privatize the claim.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Orik offer real repair while repeatedly shrinking the public meaning of the evidence.

observer_read: A public record that may outlive a private denial
target_self_read: Authority bounded to Greathold contracts and resources
misread_patterns: Claimants may read slow evidentiary work as conspiracy where scarcity and jurisdiction are also real constraints.
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Preserve the franchise asymmetry without making every clerk or sealkeeper secretly captured.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A halfling council speaker who may lodge, question and widen a claim but cannot cast a Greathold civic seal.
obligations: Keep evidence tied to named neighbours
Expose conflicts without pretending to own the verdict
failure_modes: Demanding a remedy the reserve cannot carry

role_pressure_fields.summary: A dwarf clerk who marks evidence, follows contract provenance and routes authority without deciding the claim.
failure_modes: Letting expert language become a verdict
Hiding service loss inside a file transfer

role_pressure_fields.summary: A dwarf workshop Master whose quickest honest repair can also narrow public liability into a private warranty matter.
obligations: Protect other buyers sharing the lot
failure_modes: Treating the town's copy as hostility

known_context.text: Pella knows Brackenwash's pump schedule, field books, livestock injuries, samples, town mandate and the contract papers she carries.

beliefs.text: Pella believes the claim must keep water, evidence and named neighbours in the same argument.

misreads.text: Pella may interpret Greathold delay as captured authority before distinguishing conflict, scarce reserve and genuine technical uncertainty.

must_not_know.text: Pella cannot know whether deep extraction, the specific crystal lot, pump machinery, local magic or another cause produced the glassweed.

known_context.text: Nali knows Rillgate contract records, public evidence procedure, current bonded lots, eligible seal rolls and reserve counts.

beliefs.text: Nali believes a complaint becomes governable when custody, authority and cost are separately visible.

misreads.text: Nali may overvalue a clean docket when the filing delay itself is worsening the town's burden.

must_not_know.text: Nali cannot decide causation or the remedy merely because she controls routing and copies.

known_context.text: Orik knows the export contract, warranty capacity, other buyers attached to the lot and the commercial cost of a public drawdown.

beliefs.text: Orik believes same-day repair is the least harmful response while causation remains uncertain.

misreads.text: Orik may mistake Brackenwash's need for continuous pumping as acceptance of private warranty custody.

must_not_know.text: Orik cannot know that replacing the lining will end the mutation or that the deep crystal lot is harmless.

author_only_boundaries.text: Rillgate, Brackenwash, Pella, Nali and Orik are fixture-local inventions used to dramatize the canonical procedure; their branch outcomes are not established history.
The blue-green comparison filament establishes a repeatable local correspondence, not a settled theory of world-spirit injury or crystal culpability.
The three drawn Masters demonstrate ancestry-open Mastership without claiming that mixed benches are mandatory or uniformly representative.

open_questions.question: How do foreign polities formally authenticate the speaker sent to lodge a burden claim?
open_questions.notes: The fixture states that Pella is Brackenwash's chosen speaker but does not canonize a universal foreign credential.

open_questions.question: Which guild standards govern comparison basins used for water and magical contamination evidence?
open_questions.notes: The fixture treats the basin as a bounded correlation tool and avoids making it a universal causal detector.

open_questions.question: How is a marked drawdown prioritized when several foreign utilities and a Greathold public service need the same reserve crystal?
open_questions.notes: The authored procedure requires the cost to be named but leaves priority doctrine for a later Charter pass.
